existingWfsAssessment.disjointGeometryInterpretation: Not established. A parts-capable geometry path could resolve this only if the two records are intended parts of one cadastral entity and preserve the entity's full footprint. Current evidence proves repeated keys and distinct polygons only.
existingWfsAssessment.providerNativeKey: No alternate durable native field proven. GeoServer FIDs differ but are transport row IDs, not established cadastral identity.
